cells.value: Key assurance parameters for audit readiness
Trial balance and financial statement mapping
ERP/general ledger; consolidation and reporting tool
Final trial balance; chart-of-accounts mapping; financial statement mapping; approved reporting pack
Debits equal credits; all entities and accounts included; trial balance agrees to consolidation and financial statements; no unexplained unmapped accounts; preparer and reviewer approval retained
Treasury management system; ERP cash module; bank portal
December reconciliations; bank statements; GL cash detail; outstanding-item listing; reviewer sign-off
All material accounts included; adjusted bank balance equals GL; reconciling items supported; stale items identified; account, currency, and period consistent; independent review documented
ERP accounts receivable; bank portal; cash-application system
AR ageing; customer ledger; invoices; credit notes; bank receipts; remittance advice
Ageing generated as at 31 December 2025; totals agree to GL; all open items included; ageing buckets correctly calculated; sampled receipts trace from invoice to bank; disputes and credits identified
ERP accounts payable; procurement tool; payment platform
AP ageing; vendor ledger; January 2026 payments; invoices; purchase orders; goods receipts; accrual analysis
Ageing agrees to GL; post-year-end payment population complete; invoices agree to payments; goods received before year-end assessed for accrual; duplicates investigated; review documented
Fixed asset register; ERP fixed-assets module; procurement tool
Asset roll-forward; asset register; invoices; capital approvals; in-service evidence; disposal approvals

Opening balance agrees to prior year; additions and disposals supported; closing balance agrees to GL; depreciation recalculates; useful lives and methods documented; recognition dates support proper cut-off
ERP general ledger; journal workflow; document repository
Complete JE population; journal forms; calculations; source support; approval history; posting logs

Population is complete; manual entries identifiable; totals reconcile to GL; business rationale and support retained; preparer and approver are segregated; late and post-close entries separately identified
Payroll system; HRIS; ERP general ledger; payment platform
Payroll registers; GL reconciliation; employee master data; pay-change approvals; payment control totals
All regular and off-cycle runs included; payroll agrees to GL and bank totals; sampled employees agree to HR records; hires, leavers, and pay changes authorized; personal data protected
Billing or revenue subledger; CRM; contract repository; ERP
Revenue listing; executed contracts; orders; invoices; delivery or service evidence; recognition calculations; credit notes

All material revenue streams included; population agrees to GL; samples agree to contracts and invoices; performance evidence supports recognition; cut-off is correct; modifications and credits assessed
Identity and access management; ERP security; HRIS; service-management tool
User listing; privileged-role listing; completed access review; approval record; termination report; removal tickets

System-generated population is complete; users agree to HR status; privileged and generic accounts identified; authorized reviewer decisions retained; inappropriate access remediated; removal dates tested
IT service-management system; source control; CI/CD platform; testing repository
Change population; change tickets; approvals; testing evidence; deployment logs; rollback plans; emergency-change reviews

Production-change population complete; approval and testing precede deployment; change agrees to source-control and deployment records; segregation conflicts flagged; emergency changes retrospectively reviewed
Defines the legal entities, business units, accounts, systems, and locations covered
Identifies whether the evidence represents the full population or selected audit samples
Records the accountable Finance, IT, or business owner
Identifies the authoritative system from which evidence originated
Records filters, dates, entities, accounts, and other extraction criteria
Establishes when the evidence was generated
Demonstrates that all in-scope records are included
Connects evidence totals to the GL, subledger, bank, or another authoritative source
Confirms transactions and balances relate to the correct accounting period
Traces each audit conclusion from source system through report and supporting documents
Records identified gaps, owners, remediation, and resolution
Documents redaction, masking, encryption, and access restrictions
Prevents ambiguity between draft, revised, and final evidence
Links each file to the relevant PBC request, control, sample, or workpaper
Not started, in progress, exception, audit-ready, submitted, or accepted
